text: むし　ポケモンが　だいすきで　ここに　よく　くるんだ！

structure.jp: むし　ポケモンが　だいすきで
ここに　よく　くるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the て-form of だ, joining this part to the next and giving the reason for it. だいすきで = 'I love them, so'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end, said as んだ in speech, gives the sentence an explaining tone. くるんだ = 'you see, I come'.

patterns.name: 〜が好きだ
patterns.span: ポケモンが　だいすき
patterns.explanation: With すき and だいすき the thing you like takes が, not を. ポケモンが　だいすき = 'I love Pokémon'.
